items.name: mus_morning
items.text: Light, playful baroque chamber music: pizzicato strings and harpsichord, bouncy and curious, a little cheeky, D major, about 104 bpm, a gentle comedy about an absent-minded scholar's morning in an old college. It starts at once with a single plucked note. Instrumental, no vocals.

items.name: mus_noon
items.text: Bright strolling pizzicato strings with harpsichord, a sunny noon walk round a small walled garden, steady walking rhythm, D major, 108 bpm, light and witty. Instrumental, no vocals.

items.name: mus_lecture
items.text: Sparse, dry, deadpan baroque comedy: solo harpsichord with a bassoon, slow and stately, a professor lecturing to an empty hall, slightly absurd, G major, 84 bpm. Instrumental, no vocals.

items.name: mus_supper
items.text: Warm golden evening baroque: slow harpsichord and a viola, gentle and a little lonely, a supper left to go cold, F major, 72 bpm. Instrumental, no vocals.

items.name: mus_night
items.text: Moonlit nocturne: plucked lute and harp over sustained dark strings, mysterious and calm, a furnace glowing in a garden at night, D minor, 66 bpm. Instrumental, no vocals.

items.name: mus_cello
items.text: One single sustained solo cello note, a low D, bowed slowly with gentle vibrato, swelling and then fading away. Nothing else, no other instruments. Instrumental, no vocals.

items.name: mus_laugh
items.text: Warm, tender return of a playful pizzicato and harpsichord theme over gentle sustained strings, the feeling of finally sharing a laugh late at night, D major, 96 bpm, resolving gently and ending on one single plucked note. Instrumental, no vocals.

items.name: amb_stairs
items.text: Early morning inside an old stone college staircase: birdsong outside a window, a quiet wooden building, distant sparrows and a blackbird.

items.name: amb_room
items.text: Room tone of an old wood-panelled study in the daytime, faint birds outside the window, a clock ticking very faintly.

items.name: sfx_quill
items.text: A goose-feather quill pen scratching steadily on paper, continuous writing.

items.name: amb_garden
items.text: A small walled college garden at noon: birds, a light breeze in hedges, distant church bells far off, peaceful.

items.name: amb_street
items.text: A cobbled 17th-century town street: a horse and cart passing, distant voices, footsteps on cobbles, a dog barking far away.

items.name: amb_hall
items.text: Large empty stone lecture hall room tone with a faint long echo, dust, stillness.

items.name: sfx_fly
items.text: A single house fly buzzing around close by, landing and taking off.

items.name: amb_night
items.text: A garden at night: crickets chirping, a light breeze, an owl very far away.

items.name: amb_furnace
items.text: A roaring fire inside a brick furnace, steady roar with crackling coals.

items.name: amb_embers
items.text: Deep red embers in a brick furnace, gentle crackles and a slow breathing glow of fire.

items.name: sfx_knock
items.text: Two quick raps of a hard object on an old oak door.

items.name: sfx_door_shut
items.text: A heavy old oak door shut firmly in someone's face, thud and an iron latch clicking.

items.name: sfx_pigeon
items.text: A pigeon flapping its wings and flying off a stone window sill.

items.name: sfx_stairs_up
items.text: Someone running up the last two wooden stair steps quickly.

items.name: sfx_door_crack
items.text: An old wooden door opening a crack with a faint creak and closing again carefully with a click.

items.name: sfx_stairs_down
items.text: Footsteps going down a wooden staircase, unhurried, fading away.

items.name: sfx_lid
items.text: Lifting a metal pewter dish cover off a plate, a small metallic clink.

items.name: sfx_bell
items.text: A distant college bell tolling once, far away across rooftops.

items.name: sfx_gravel
items.text: Footsteps walking slowly on a raked gravel path.

items.name: sfx_gravel_run
items.text: A man suddenly turns and runs away fast across gravel and up stone steps.

items.name: sfx_whoosh
items.text: A fast whip-pan whoosh, air swish.

items.name: sfx_chair
items.text: A wooden chair dragged across old wooden floorboards.

items.name: sfx_wipe
items.text: Two quick strokes of a cloth handkerchief wiping skin.

items.name: sfx_big_door
items.text: A large old wooden door creaking open slowly.

items.name: sfx_steps_echo
items.text: Footsteps walking into an empty stone hall with echo.

items.name: sfx_clap
items.text: One person clapping slowly three times alone in a big empty hall, each clap echoing.

items.name: sfx_fork
items.text: A fork clinking against a pewter plate.

items.name: sfx_chew
items.text: A man chewing a mouthful of bread.

items.name: sfx_shovel
items.text: A shovel of charcoal tipped into a roaring furnace, coals sliding and sparks.

items.name: sfx_poke
items.text: An iron poker stirring burning coals in a furnace.

items.name: sfx_spit
items.text: A fire spits and pops loudly, a burst of sparks.

items.name: sfx_clock_two
items.text: A distant town church clock striking two, two deep bell strokes, at night.

items.name: sfx_board
items.text: A small wooden board sliding off a knee and clattering onto a stone floor.

items.name: sfx_sack
items.text: A heavy sack of charcoal dropped on a stone floor, a dull thump and coals shifting.

items.name: sfx_paper
items.text: A sheaf of papers being shuffled and tapped straight on a desk.

items.name: sfx_pluck
items.text: One single plucked violin note, pizzicato, D.

items.name: sfx_card
items.text: A small paper slip fluttering and landing on a table.

items.name: laugh_1
items.text: [bursts out laughing helplessly, a rusty, real laugh] Ha! Ha ha ha ha... ha ha ha!

items.name: laugh_2
items.text: [bursts out laughing helplessly, a rusty, real laugh] Ha! Ha ha ha ha... ha ha ha!

items.name: laugh_3
items.text: [bursts out laughing helplessly, a rusty, real laugh] Ha! Ha ha ha ha... ha ha ha!

items.name: whatuse_1
items.text: [still laughing, incredulous] What... use!

items.name: whatuse_2
items.text: [still laughing, incredulous] What... use!
